parsed.name: 变温实验控制后端与界面组件
parsed.name_en: Variable-Temperature Experiment Control Backend and GUI Component
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于协调 Keithley 2400、Keithley 2182 和 Lakeshore 350 的连接、配置、温度斜坡控制、测量采集以及实验界面状态管理，适合变温电学测量流程。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component that coordinates connection, configuration, temperature ramp control, measurement acquisition, and GUI state management for a Keithley 2400, Keithley 2182, and Lakeshore 350 in variable-temperature electrical measurement workflows.

actions.description: 配置 Keithley 2400、Keithley 2182 和 Lakeshore 350 的实验参数。
actions.description_en: Configure experiment parameters for the Keithley 2400, Keithley 2182, and Lakeshore 350.

actions.description: 连接到 K2400、K2182 和 Lakeshore 350 的通信地址。
actions.description_en: Connect to the communication addresses of the K2400, K2182, and Lakeshore 350.

actions.description: 设置 Lakeshore 温控输出的加热量程。
actions.description_en: Set the heater range for a Lakeshore temperature-control output.

actions.description: 设置 Lakeshore 温控输出的目标温度。
actions.description_en: Set the target temperature for a Lakeshore temperature-control output.

actions.description: 停止实验并关闭相关仪器连接与输出。
actions.description_en: Stop the experiment and shut down related instrument connections and outputs.

actions.description: 启动到目标温度的升降温斜坡控制。
actions.description_en: Start a temperature ramp to the target temperature.

actions.description: 设置图形界面的显示样式。
actions.description_en: Set up the visual styles of the graphical user interface.

actions.description: 创建实验控制界面的控件。
actions.description_en: Create widgets for the experiment control interface.

actions.description: 记录实验运行过程中的日志信息。
